quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two commercially relevant organizer contacts are verified: Nicolas Simonin, Responsable développement tourisme/transport at Genève Aéroport, named workshop organizer and official exhibitor registration contact (nicolas.simonin@gva.ch); and Yves-Daniel Viredaz, Head of Business Development, named workshop organizer and senior relationship contact. Their relevance is organizer access and clarification of demand/introductions, not proven authority over hotel contracts. No named housing manager or lodging buyer was identified.
findings.futureEdition: 27 May 2027, a single-day fifth edition at Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland (Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva or Founex). TRAVEL INSIDE published the actual activity date on 12 October 2026; the Swiss Travel Federation calendar independently lists “27 mai 2027” and “by Genève Aéroport”. This is within the requested horizon. Important provenance limit: the airport’s own workshop page still advertises 4 June 2026; a 2027 owner-issued programme was not located. No announced 2028 edition was found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied YOTEL specifications: the airport-corridor geography is relevant, but YOTEL in Founex is not the on-airport venue. Best conceivable roles are independently booked airline/organizer overnight stays or a separately commissioned small briefing; neither is evidenced yet. Historical workshop scale does not establish room demand: 2026 reported 90 travel agents/Travel Managers plus airline representatives, not 90 sleepers. The hotel’s 237 rooms and six meeting rooms do not justify a 20–120-room block assumption. No relocation, project mobilisation, extended-stay or resort-retreat demand is evidenced. Do not pitch a full-house buyout or assume banquet/catering capacity.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 venue publicly announced as Restaurant Le Chef, Geneva Airport. Restaurant address: Route de l’aéroport 13, third floor, CH-1215 Genève, Switzerland. It is a restaurant, not an incumbent hotel. Venue selection is evidenced; a signed venue contract is not public. The 2027 announcement anticipates workshop meetings, a conference/debate and a cocktail dinner. No hotel venue or accommodation commitment is published.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented editions: 22 June 2023; 6 June 2024; 22 May 2025; 4 June 2026. All used Restaurant Le Chef at Geneva Airport. The announced fifth edition returns there on 27 May 2027: repeated same-site use, not destination rotation. An early June 2025 notice gave 28 May 2026, but the later official 2026 programme gives 4 June 2026; use the latter. Annual recurrence is documented for 2023–2027, but no exact 2028 date is established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown, not open. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, room block, booking code, accommodation RFP, peak rooms or room-nights was found in the reviewed 2027 announcement/calendar or official 2026 materials. The official registration instruction is “Confirmez votre inscription à l’aide du formulaire joint à nous retourner par email (nicolas.simonin@gva.ch)”: this is exhibitor/event registration, not hotel booking. The 2026 exhibitor package lists a table, chairs, two airline representatives, parking and Wi-Fi; it does not publish lodging. Therefore independently bookable overnight demand is unverified. No committed hotels can be named.
findings.organizationStructure: Event owner/organizer: Genève Aéroport, through its Marketing / Business Development team. Genève Aéroport describes itself as an autonomous public establishment owned by the State of Geneva; this is an airport-led trade event, not an association-owned conference. TRAVEL INSIDE is explicitly the media partner, not the demonstrated event owner; its Primus Publishing footer is not evidence of event procurement authority. Restaurant Le Chef is the venue. Eventwise hosts the registration pages; no PCO/DMC appointment or hotel-buying mandate is evidenced.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Le Chef is the established and announced competing meeting/catering venue, not a competing hotel. Four historical editions and the 2027 return make displacement of the core workshop commercially unlikely (inference). No hotel sell-out, overflow need or contracted accommodation competitor is evidenced. A third-party 2026 listing displays “Featured Hotels”: ibis Genève Aéroport, Nash Pratik Hotel, Nash Airport Hotel and Nash Suites Airport Hotel. These are generic commercial recommendations, not an official event hotel list or booking commitments; do not treat them as incumbent blocks.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nicolas Simonin first via his published airport email, referencing the announced 27 May 2027 edition. Ask whether the date/Le Chef venue is owner-confirmed, who actually needs overnight accommodation, whether lodging is centrally contracted or individually booked, and who can approve hotel introductions. Request published quantities and arrival/departure nights if any. Ask for an introduction to Yves-Daniel Viredaz for a targeted airport-travel-trade relationship discussion. Do not send an unsolicited room-block bid or assume hotels may exhibit: the 2026 exhibitor tariff expressly covers one airline per table, with limited alliance sharing. Advance to a priced YOTEL proposal only after lodging independence, named demand and transfer practicality are confirmed; otherwise retain as trade relationship development rather than an accommodation lead.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the forthcoming 2027 edition, core meeting/catering venue access appears closed by the published Le Chef selection; accommodation accessibility remains unconfirmed, not proven closed or open. The 2026 event ran from afternoon registration through 21:00, and targeted regional travel professionals. Historical 2024 sourcing offered “billets de train offerts par les CFF aux agents de voyages et chargés de voyages de Lausanne et au-delà” with a “billet aller et retour”. This supports regional day-return attendance, not overnight demand; it is not a confirmed 2027 transport offer. The event itself is in the Swiss Geneva Airport corridor, not Lausanne or French Pays de Gex; no evidence establishes 2027 delegates flying in or lodging toward La Côte.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development potential, not a qualified future room-demand cycle. Verified same-airport recurrence provides a reason to maintain contact, but no rotation, hotel RFP or 2028 edition has been published. Offer YOTEL only if the organizer confirms independently bookable non-local airline/organizer lodging, a hotel introduction pathway, or a separate small meeting requirement. Any future room volume must come from named demand; do not extrapolate historical attendance into rooms or assume the venue will rotate.
